candidate.family: Cardinality of Set Union and Intersection
candidate.nl_statement: For any finite sets \(A\) and \(B\), the cardinality of the union of \(A\) and \(B\) is equal to the sum of the cardinalities of \(A\) and \(B\) minus the cardinality of their intersection.
candidate.proof_block:
by
  classical
  have h1 : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card (B \ A) := by
    rw [Set.union_eq_add_diff_inter]
  have h2 : card (B \ A) = card B - card (A ∩ B) := by
    rw [Set.diff_eq_sub, Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset, Set.subset_def, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_inter, Set.mem_singleton]
    exact fun x => by
      cases x
      exact Set.mem_singleton_self x
  rw [h1, h2]

  List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < n) l) ≤ List.length l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h1 : x < n ∨ x ≥ n := exact (x < n) ∨ (x ≥ n)
    split
    · exactI ih
    · exactI (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le n) (Nat.le_refl x) (h1))
END FORMAT EXAMPLE.
